description: The bar chart, titled "Quality Scores," compares the performance of three different methods—IFD, TagNum, and DEITA—across two metrics: Avg_sub and Avg_obj. The vertical axis represents "Scores" on a linear scale ranging from 30 to 70, with major tick marks at intervals of 5. The horizontal axis displays the three methods. For each method, two bars are shown: a light blue bar for Avg_obj and an orange bar for Avg_sub. The chart includes two horizontal reference lines: a dashed blue line at 64.71, labeled "Base Avg_sub," and a dashed yellow line at 37.91, labeled "Avg_sub." The values for each bar are explicitly labeled: for IFD, Avg_obj is 63.98 and Avg_sub is 41.90; for TagNum, Avg_obj is 66.06 and Avg_sub is 39.13; for DEITA, Avg_obj is 67.64 and Avg_sub is 42.99. The legend clarifies that the light blue bars represent Avg_obj and the orange bars represent Avg_sub. The data shows that DEITA achieves the highest Avg_obj score, while TagNum has the lowest Avg_sub score.
